_what: The Billing screen's words and the parts of a deal a person can switch, owned by src/billing-screen.mjs (decision source:cHJpY2luZy1hbmQtYmlsbGluZy11c2FnZS1zcG90cy1iaWxsaW5nLXNjcmVlbi1zZXR0aW5ncy0yMDI2LTEwLTA1). Spots and usage parts come from the offers a person pays for or is paid for (records/commercial-offer-records.json, src/usage-meters.json), so a new offer, price, meter or negotiated deal shows here with no change to this file. `parts` are the extra parts of a deal: a part with `covers` (a formula-engine rule tree over the facts of a piece of the store's work: purpose, entry) is work the person can switch off, which keeps one use budget row (src/metered-use.mjs, id `deal-part:<id>`) that stops that work, so it is neither done nor charged until it is switched on again; a part with `state` only says where it stands in every deal today. Adding a part is one row here.

parts.label: Trillion reading what you keep in the background
parts.detail: Your pursuits, values and what you are doing now, worked out continuously from what comes in. Off, nothing is read in the background and that work is not charged.

parts.label: Search inside your files and recordings
parts.detail: The words inside documents, what is said in recordings and video previews, kept ready to search. Off, new files are not read for search and that work is not charged.

parts.label: AI apps as members
parts.detail: An AI app you connect can hold a spot like a person does. No deal charges for AI apps today.
